notes: One entry per registry school. games are the league’s own second-level schedule page (lib/sports/shape.ts TeamsidelineSportSeason.pages.second), read as the varsity build reads its main page (lib/sources/teamsideline-games.ts); league says whether it was read this run.
MaxPreps and si.com carry none of these schools, so both are unavailable for every team.

JV games are kept apart from the main level: no table, leader board, rating or playoff picture of the main level reads them. games are stored unclassified; lib/jv/jv-standings.ts decides at load which second-level table each counts for, from its main-level counterpart.
A league page that cannot be read keeps the previous file’s games (league status carried-forward, with the previous read’s fetchedAt).
